correctness.rationale: For S subset E(K_n) as a total dominating vertex set in T_n=L(K_n), open-edge incidence requires that its spanning selected graph F have at most one isolated vertex and no K2 connected component; all selected edges must meet another distinct selected edge. Inclusion minimality excludes cycles. With no isolate, every component must be P3, since removing a pendant edge from any larger tree creates one permitted isolate without leaving K2. With one isolate, every nonpendant selected edge must cut off a K2 component on one side, forcing component core of nonleaves to diameter <=2, hence a star with arms independently subdivided at most once; at least two arms. Conversely each described forest is minimal. Labeled EGF is exp(z²u³/2)-1-u + u exp(B), B=u(exp(zu+z²u²)-1-zu-z²u²)-z³u⁴/2; the P4 double-hub correction is essential. This yields gamma_t(T_n)=floor(2n/3), upper Gamma_t=2 for n3 else n-2, and the exact n mod 3 minimum-set count formulas in RESULT. Independently enumerated every candidate subset of K_n edges for n=3..6 using actual open-neighborhood total domination plus one-edge deletion minimality, reproducing M3={2:3}, M4={2:12}, M5={3:80}, M6={4:840}. Source n7 output {4:630,5:3402} was not rerun, and finite verification is not substituted for the all-n tree/spider proof.
